episode_policy.state_partition_semantics: episodes split only when the source-preserving four-field status tuple changes; no active/closed/reopened semantic mapping is applied
episode_policy.episode_number_policy: 1-based order within one permit and one observation window; deterministic for that input window but not a persistent identity across wider future history windows
episode_policy.first_episode_start: LEFT_CENSORED: true start is on or before first_observed_date and is not inferred from permit_date
episode_policy.between_episode_boundary: INTERVAL_CENSORED: transition is after the prior episode last_observed_date and on or before the next episode first_observed_date
episode_policy.last_episode_end: RIGHT_CENSORED: state is observed through last_observed_date with no terminal-event assertion after that date
episode_policy.closure_date_policy: closure date is retained only as first/last source observation context; it does not define the episode boundary and is not a permanent terminal event
episode_policy.status_code_05_policy: retain raw source value without canonical semantic mapping

columns.name: start_boundary_lower_date
columns.meaning: exclusive lower bound for a known between-episode transition; null for a left-censored first episode

columns.name: end_boundary_lower_date
columns.meaning: exclusive transition lower bound for a following episode or right-censoring observation date; equals last_observed_date

columns.name: end_boundary_upper_date
columns.meaning: inclusive upper bound from the next episode first_observed_date; null for right-censored final episode

row_invariants: RIGHT_CENSORED implies end_boundary_upper_date is null and right_censored is true
INTERVAL_CENSORED end implies end_boundary_upper_date is non-null, end_boundary_lower_date < end_boundary_upper_date, and right_censored is false
episode_number is unique only within source_key + management_number + observation window
